title: Airport Pickup, Carbyn's Cove Beach & Cellular Jail Light & Sound Show
description:
Airport Welcome: Arrive at Veer Savarkar International Airport, Port Blair, where our HappyFlying representative greets you with warmth and assists with a smooth transfer to your hotel. Take time to refresh.

Carbyn's Cove Beach: Start the afternoon at Carbyn's Cove, a palm-fringed beach just a short drive from the city. Stroll along the shoreline, enjoy the sea breeze, or relax by the turquoise waters.

Cellular Jail Visit & Light & Sound Show: In the afternoon, visit the iconic Cellular Jail (Kala Pani) and witness the historic Light & Sound Show bringing India's heroic freedom struggle to life.
morning: Warm airport reception and transfer to your Port Blair hotel in a private AC vehicle.
afternoon: Scenic seaside drive and leisure at Carbyn's Cove Beach.
evening: Cellular Jail historic walkthrough followed by the iconic evening Light and Sound Show.
overnight: Overnight stay at Hotel in Port Blair

transfers.title: Airport to Hotel Transfer
transfers.details: Point to point pickup within city limits

importantNote: Airport pickup is timed according to your flight arrival. Keep a copy of your government ID ready.

title: Port Blair to Havelock (Private Cruise) & Radhanagar Beach Sunset
description:
Private Cruise to Havelock: In the morning, board a premium private catamaran cruise (Makruzz / Nautika in Premium Class) sailing across the sparkling blue waters to Havelock Island.

Resort Check-In: On arrival at Havelock Jetty, our on-ground team transfers you to your beach resort for check-in and lunch.

Radhanagar Beach Sunset: In the afternoon, visit world-renowned Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7). Walk along powdery white sands and witness an unforgettable tropical sunset.
morning: Early morning checkout and private catamaran cruise to Havelock Island (Makruzz/Nautika).
afternoon: Hotel check-in at Havelock and leisure time in the resort.
evening: Excursion to Radhanagar Beach to witness one of Asia's finest golden sunsets.
overnight: Overnight stay at Beach Resort in Havelock Island
importantNote: Ferry tickets are issued with assigned seating. Please arrive at the jetty 45 minutes prior to departure.

title: Elephant Beach Snorkeling & Cruise to Neil Island
description:
Speedboat to Elephant Beach: Board a speedboat to Elephant Beach, home to one of Havelock's richest living coral reefs.

Complimentary Snorkeling: Experience vibrant underwater life with a guided snorkeling session.

Cruise to Neil Island: Return to resort, check out, and board your afternoon catamaran cruise to picturesque Neil Island.

Laxmanpur Beach Sunset: Enjoy a serene evening sunset at Laxmanpur Beach.
morning: Speedboat trip to Elephant Beach with complimentary guided coral reef snorkeling.
afternoon: Cruise from Havelock to Neil Island and resort check-in.
evening: Sunset walk along the tranquil sands of Laxmanpur Beach.
overnight: Overnight stay at Resort in Neil Island

transfers.title: Resort to Elephant Beach Speedboat Jetty

importantNote: Snorkeling is subject to local harbor master guidelines and weather safety regulations.

title: Natural Rock Formation, Bharatpur Beach & Return to Port Blair
description:
Natural Rock Formation: Visit Neil Island's natural living coral wonder, popularly called the Howrah Bridge, carved by ocean waves over centuries.

Bharatpur Beach: Explore the calm shallow lagoon of Bharatpur Beach, ideal for swimming and leisure.

Cruise to Port Blair: Board your private catamaran cruise back to Port Blair and check in to your hotel for your final evening.
morning: Explore the Natural Rock Formation and Bharatpur Beach coral lagoon.
afternoon: Catamaran cruise from Neil Island back to Port Blair.
evening: Hotel check-in at Port Blair and evening shopping at Aberdeen Bazaar for local souvenirs.
overnight: Overnight stay at Hotel in Port Blair
importantNote: Wear comfortable walking shoes with grip for the coral walkway at Natural Rock Formation.

title: Drop to Port Blair Airport with Sweet Memories
description: Check out from your hotel with heart-warming memories of your exotic Andaman island adventure. Our representative drops you safely at Veer Savarkar International Airport for your flight back home.
morning: Hotel checkout and assisted transfer to Port Blair Airport.
afternoon: Departure flight to your home city.

transfers.title: Hotel to Port Blair Airport Drop

importantNote: Please verify your flight schedule. Packed breakfast provided for early morning flight departures.
